text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Fine Motion—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wooww... Ahaha♪ There are so many 
plushies!

Looking where Fine Motion pointed, there 
was a claw machine filled with stuffed 
toys modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's play! I'm definitely winning 
one today!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah... to be honest, I'm not very good at 
these. I've never managed to win anything 
even once...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If I fail again today, I'm going to order 
this entire machine and practice with 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Really? Well then, I'd love your 
help!
—I can't afford to lose this game!!
